target.title: fix(qa): restore fast smoke profile evidence
target.body:
Related: #99705
Related: #99743

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the required QA Smoke CI job grew from roughly 5–6 minutes to 11–13 minutes and began failing intermittently after smoke-linked QA scenarios started running full Docker package builds.

The added Docker runs rebuilt the complete distribution after the normal smoke flows had finished. Under CI contention, those duplicate `tsdown` builds also exhausted the 8 GB Node heap and failed otherwise unrelated pull requests.

## Why This Change Was Made

Partially revert #99705 for the two scenarios whose taxonomy coverage places them in `smoke-ci`:

- restore focused Vitest assertion coverage for native OpenAI web search request logs;
- restore focused Vitest parsing and process-control coverage for the plugin lifecycle probe.

The other four scenarios added by #99705 remain on the shared Docker lane adapter because their taxonomy categories keep them in release-oriented profiles. Taxonomy category IDs remain the single source of truth for profile selection; this does not add a second profile allowlist.

## User Impact

Contributors should see the required QA Smoke job return to its fast deterministic path, with fewer unrelated reruns and no duplicate package builds. Release and dedicated Docker E2E coverage remain available for the full runtime scenarios.

## Evidence

- Before regression: sampled June 26 QA Smoke jobs completed in approximately 4m40s–6m27s.
- After #99705/#99736: sampled July 4 jobs took approximately 10m22s–13m33s.
- Failed July 4 artifacts showed both newly selected Docker scenarios dying during their own `tsdown` package builds with `FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit` near the 8 GB heap ceiling.
- Resolved smoke taxonomy proof: zero scenarios use `test/e2e/qa-lab/runtime/docker-e2e-lane.ts`; the two affected scenarios resolve to their focused Vitest files.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-lab/src/scenario-catalog.test.ts test/e2e/qa-lab/runtime/openai-web-search-minimal-assertions.e2e.test.ts test/e2e/qa-lab/plugins/plugin-lifecycle-probe.e2e.test.ts` — 47/47 passed.
- `pnpm format:check ...` for all touched files — passed.
- Full remote `smoke-ci` profile — 25/25 passed; QA command completed in 2m03s, full remote command in 3m00s.
  - Blacksmith Testbox-through-Crabbox: `tbx_01kwnh71vt65t2c9krr65r38jy`
  - Actions run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28692916404
- Structured Codex autoreview — no accepted/actionable findings; patch correct at 0.94 confidence.
